summary: Importing tickets from .csv/.tsv/.xlsx into a project board: the preview, the row-level problem reporting, and what actually gets created. Covers the desktop shell and the phone browser served by opcode-web.

environments.notes: opcode-web on the LAN. Narrowest phone still supported.
Checked with the on-screen keyboard open.

cases.title: A well-formed CSV previews every row before anything is created
cases.preconditions: A project board exists and is empty.
steps: Open Tasks and press Import
Choose a CSV with four valid rows
Read the preview table
cases.expected: All four rows are listed, none is marked with a problem, and the board still has no tickets.
cases.actual: As expected. Preview showed 4 ready, 0 skipped.

cases.title: An empty sheet imports nothing instead of failing
steps: Import a CSV containing only a heading row
cases.expected: Preview shows zero rows, the Import button is disabled, and no error is raised.

cases.title: A misspelt heading is named rather than dropped in silence
steps: Import a CSV whose second column is spelt "epci"
cases.expected: The preview lists "epci" under columns that were not understood; the other columns still import.
cases.notes: This is the case that stops a typo from quietly losing a whole column.

cases.title: A ragged row imports what it can and reports the rest
steps: Import a CSV where one row has two cells and another has six
cases.expected: Short rows fill the missing fields with defaults; over-long rows keep the columns that map and ignore the rest. No row sinks the import.

cases.title: A row with no title is skipped with its reason shown
steps: Import a CSV where row 3 has an empty title
Read row 3 in the preview
cases.expected: Row 3 is greyed out and carries the reason it cannot become a ticket; the count reads "1 will be skipped".

cases.title: An unknown priority falls back to medium rather than rejecting the row
steps: Import a row whose priority reads "urgent-ish"
cases.expected: The ticket is created at medium priority and the substitution is visible in the preview.
cases.actual: Ticket created at medium. The preview shows "medium" but does not say it was substituted.
cases.notes: Behaviour is right; the preview is quiet about it.

cases.title: Row numbers in the preview match what the spreadsheet shows
steps: Import a sheet with two blank lines before the headings
Compare a row's number with Excel's
cases.expected: A problem on the fifth line of the file is reported as row 5, not row 3.

cases.title: A real .xlsx workbook reads back as tickets
steps: Save the template as .xlsx in Excel
Import the .xlsx
cases.expected: The same tickets appear as from the CSV; the preview names the sheet it read.

cases.title: A file that is not a spreadsheet at all is refused with a readable message
steps: Rename a PNG to tickets.csv
Import it
cases.expected: An error naming the file and what went wrong; no tickets created, no crash.
cases.actual: Error shown in the dialog, nothing created.

cases.title: A sheet of 2,000 rows previews without freezing the window
steps: Generate a 2,000-row CSV
Import it and time the preview
cases.expected: The preview appears in under 3s and the list scrolls smoothly.
cases.actual: Preview in ~1.2s; the table scrolls without dropping frames.

cases.title: Non-ASCII titles survive the round trip
steps: Import a row titled "लॉगिन ठीक करें — 日本語"
Read the ticket on the board
cases.test_data: UTF-8 with an em dash and Devanagari
cases.expected: The title on the card is byte-for-byte what was in the sheet.

cases.title: The import dialog is usable at 375px without horizontal scroll
steps: Open the board on an iPhone SE
Press Import
Scroll the preview table
cases.expected: The dialog fits the viewport, every control is reachable, and only the preview table scrolls sideways.
cases.actual: Dialog fits. The preview table scrolls sideways inside its own container as intended.

cases.title: Tap targets in the preview are at least 44px
steps: Open the import dialog on a Pixel 8
Measure the Cancel and Import buttons
cases.expected: Both buttons are at least 44x44 CSS px and are not overlapped by the home-gesture area.
cases.actual: Import is 44px tall. Cancel is 36px and sits 6px above the gesture bar.

cases.title: Rotating the phone mid-preview keeps the parsed rows
steps: Preview a file in portrait
Rotate to landscape
cases.expected: The same rows are still listed; the file is not re-read and nothing is lost.

cases.title: An import that loses the network part-way through says so
steps: Start an import of 200 rows
Put the phone into airplane mode before it finishes
cases.expected: A readable failure, the dialog stays open, and the board is not left half-imported.
cases.actual: Not reached - the run ended before this was exercised.
cases.notes: Needs a network-throttling harness; see "Not covered".

mobile_checks.check: Import dialog fits and every control is reachable
Import dialog fits and every control is reachable
mobile_checks.notes: Dynamic Island does not overlap the header.

mobile_checks.check: Import dialog fits and every control is reachable
Preview usable in landscape with the keyboard open
mobile_checks.notes: Footer buttons stay visible above the keyboard.
No throttling harness in this run.

mobile_checks.check: Text at 200% system font size does not clip

defects.title: Cancel button in the import dialog is below the 44px minimum tap target on phones
steps: Open the board in a phone browser at 412px wide
Press Import
Measure the Cancel button in the footer
defects.expected: At least 44x44 CSS px, clear of the home-gesture area.
defects.actual: 36px tall, 6px above the gesture bar, so it is easy to miss or to trigger the gesture instead.
defects.environment: Pixel 8 / Android 15 / Chrome 129; also iPhone SE / iOS 18.4 / Safari
defects.notes: The footer uses the desktop button size unconditionally.

defects.title: An unrecognised priority is silently replaced with medium
steps: Import a row whose priority reads "urgent-ish"
Read the preview row
defects.expected: The preview says the priority was not understood and what it will be instead.
defects.actual: The preview shows "medium" with nothing to say it was substituted, which reads as if the sheet said medium.
defects.notes: Same class of problem as the misspelt-heading case, which is reported properly.

coverage.requirement: Nothing is created until the person confirms the preview
A heading that is not understood is named, not ignored
A bad row is skipped with its reason and does not sink the import
Every format calamine reads is accepted
coverage.gap: .ods, .xlsb and .xlsm were not opened in this run - only .csv, .tsv and .xlsx.

coverage.requirement: The board is usable from a phone browser
A failed import leaves the board unchanged
coverage.gap: Blocked - needs a way to interrupt the request part-way through.

not_covered: Network interruption part-way through an import (TC-15): no throttling or request-abort harness in this environment.
.ods, .xlsb and .xlsm files: readable in principle via calamine but not exercised here.
Concurrent imports into the same board from two devices at once.
Screen readers (VoiceOver / TalkBack) on the import dialog.
